symptom: Gating metric flagged tc-05 (disk_usage=92% on broker-3, a metric with no baseline rule) as a MISMATCH: labelled non-actionable / 'should gate to watch', but the pipeline opened an incident.
root_cause: A1's novel-signal path (docs/novel_signal_llm_fallback.md) deliberately promotes an unseen numeric metric on a production entity from insufficient_evidence to 'likely' and routes it to RCA, rather than silently dropping it (edge_cases.md: never silently drop high-criticality signals; state uncertainty and escalate). The original tc-05 label contradicted this documented, intentional behaviour.

fix.type: additive (test-set relabel + harness criterion); no A1-A8 node change
fix.what_changed: Re-labelled tc-05 to actionable=true in test_cases.json and aligned the harness gating criterion with the documented novel-signal contract, so an unseen numeric metric on a prod broker is correctly treated as an opened incident.
